entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-17
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • ExecuteUpdate does not report affected rows if empty entity is created on the same open connection #37062
    11.0.0
  • Can't map Dictionary<string,object> (e.g. to JSON) since it's detected as a property bag #26903
    11.0.0
  • Use ConstructorExpression in CSharpRuntimeAnnotationCodeGenerator #36900
    11.0.0
  • Consider (not) deprecating relational owned JSON support #37290
    11.0.0
  • Deprecate owned types with ordinal keys (owned JSON collections) #37289
    11.0.0
  • Throw for unions #38376
    11.0.0

Updated

  • EF Core 5 generates duplicate FK from model #23575
    Backlog
  • Nullable navigation properties lead to unexpected outer join criteria #35706
    Backlog
  • Various model building issues #22414
    11.0.0
  • Cosmos: Projecting out nested documents retrieves the entire document #34067
    Backlog
  • 11.0 API Reviews #37993
    11.0.0
  • ArgumentOutOfRangeException when adding a migration that expands the primary key of a table with seed data #35116
    11.0.0
  • Cosmos: Anonymous and dto projections filter undefined implicitly when projecting a single property #38298
    Backlog
  • Conflicting partition key filter is ignored in ReadItem case #38238
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Mark entities as unchanged when matched by entities loaded from database #38452
  • Fix migration generation for non-nullable SqlVector columns #38451
  • Validate that foreign key property types match principal key property types #38450
  • [WIP] Fix nullable navigation properties leading to unexpected outer join #38449
  • Validate that ownership relationships keep their default DeleteBehavior and requiredness #38448
  • Validate unsupported options on full-text and vector indexes #38447
  • Throw by default for multiple owned entities set to the same instance #38446
  • Fix SQL Server password in copilot-setup-steps.yml #38445
  • Suppress redundant `[Stage]` diff line for added/removed types in API diff comment #38444
  • Fix several small issues in the compiled model #38441
  • Make type mapping generic so that it can create value comparers for NativeAOT #38440
    providers-beware
  • Don't transform Cosmos query to ReadItem when WithPartitionKey conflicts with predicate partition key #38439

Merged

  • Make some tests virtual #38443
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38437
  • Enable EnablePreviewFeatures and runtime-async=on across the repo #38442
  • Allow runtime constants in precompiled queries #38430
    community-contribution
  • Fix ExecuteUpdate returning -1 on open connections by setting NOCOUNT OFF #37827
    community-contribution
  • Apply feedback from API review #38438
  • Add entry API overloads that work correctly with nullable value properties #38425
    api-review
  • Honor explicit store type when discovering Dictionary<string,object> #38433
    community-contribution, api-review
  • Translate TimeOnly.Hour/Minute/Second on SQLite #38341
    community-contribution
  • Bump Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions from 11.0.0-beta.26263.112 to 11.0.0-beta.26312.108 #38419
    area-infrastructure
  • Use ConstructorExpression in CSharpRuntimeAnnotationCodeGenerator #38409
    api-review
  • Scope down owned JSON deprecation to just collections with a synthetic key #38395
  • Throw for unions mapped as entity or complex types #38398
  • Add validation for Index included properties inside JSON-mapped types #38404

Updated

  • Fix inverting identifying FK using wrong type and short-circuit principal type on attach #38423
  • Add DATA_COMPRESSION support for primary keys and unique constraints #38434
    community-contribution
  • Fix redundant (string)null schema argument in ToTable snapshot generation #38424
  • Move IOperationReporter, ISnapshotModelProcessor and SnapshotModelProcessor to EFCore.Relational as public API #38408
  • Fix compiled-model CreateRelationalModel() failure when an owned entity shares its owner's table #38428
  • Support conflicting partition key predicates in Cosmos queries #38240
    community-contribution
